minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, March 21, 2024
  6:30 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  March 21, 2024 / 6:30 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold, Vice Mayor Lester Friedman, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Chair Charles Smith, NEXT
  Beverly Hills Committee Vice Chair Ellen Labbe

  1) Public Comment:
  a. Allision extended her thanks to Mayor Gold for his work in the NEXT Beerly Hills
  Committee for the past 6-7 years and wishes him luck in the next chapter of his
  life.
  b. Derek: Also expressed his thanks for all the work Dr. Gold has done for NEXT and
  the work he put into setting it up and making it function as well as it is.
  c. Kaveh Farshad: Expressed his thankfulness for the work that Dr. Gold put into
  NEXT Bevely Hills and that he will be missed.
  d. Written Comment from Noah Etessami: Thanks Mayor Gold for all his years of
  service for the City and for the personal guidance the Mayor has given him.
  e. Video Message from Tiffany: Thanks Mayor Gold for establishing NEXT Beverly
  Hills and stated that it was sorely needed. She hopes that all the changes the
  committee has undergone over the years are to the mayor’s liking and wishes him
  well in the next stage of his life and hopes they can maintain a lifelong friendship.
  f. Commenter: He thanks Mayor gold or his unique ability to bring happiness and joy
  into a situation during a crisis and that he will be missed.
  g. Commenter: She thanks the Mayor for reaching out to young people with NEXT
  and working hand in hand with the committee to make it successful.
  h. Commenter: He thanks the mayor for his down-to-earth and approachable attitude
  and wishes him the best of luck in the coming years.
  i. Brian: He views this committee as essential for the city moving forward and thanks
  him for founding it.
  j. The Mayor responded by issuing his gratefulness to all the kind words and stated
  that he founded the committee to connect young people to government and to
  make their voices heard, because at the end of the day today’s young people are
  tomorrow’s community leaders. He ended with a message to encourage people to
  connect with the city and to boldly advocate for what they believe in to help make
  this city a better place.
  k. Brian: Stated the Mission Statement and proposed an event called “A Taste of
  Beverly Hills” or “Walk, Wine, & Dine on Canon” an event focused on promoting
  Beverly Hills Restaurants to the Greater Los Angeles area. The event would be
  adult focused in opposition to Next Night’s focus on young families.
 Highlights for March 21, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  2) Welcome & Introductions:
  a. Valerie Lopez: Resident
  b. Daniel DiCriscio: has attended these meetings for over a year and has worked in
  the city for around 30 years.
  c. Diana: Resident
  d. Viru Narula: Artist
  e. Kaveh Farshad: Resident
  f. Derek: Resident

  3) NEXT Beverly Hills Mission Statement:
  a. NEXT Beverly Hills is a committee of talented next generation leaders focused on
  innovative initiatives which address lifestyle, economic, and civic needs of those in
  their 20s, 30s, and 40s chartered by the mayor and the city of Beverly Hills that
  seeks to engage all that are interested to inspire them and to make Beverly Hills a
  better place for all.

  4) New Business:
  a. NEXT will begin more aggressively reaching out to schools to bring in youth
  involvement with the committee.
  b. This meeting’s NEXT Open House will be held at Cantina Frita. This will serve as
  an additional discussion and brainstorming forum.
  c. The art chair is still interested in a painting event in one of the public parks.
  d. There was also an art walkthrough at Sotheby’s earlier in the day that went
  successfully.
  e. The charity drive had scheduling issues, as it was not only on Super Bowl Sunday
  as well as during another city charity drive. It was originally planned for January
  but was pushed back so that NEXT could do additional promotion for it. However,
  the promotion happened only two days before the drive, and no newsletter went
  out.
  f. The Beverly Hills Earth Day event is on the 28th. NEXT will have a booth there as
  they have for the past two years. The theme is “People vs Plastic” but the specifics
  are still being planned.
  g. To prevent future scheduling conflicts, an editorial calendar showing scheduled
  city events is now provided at each meeting.
  h. The full NEXT Open House is still in the planning stages but is aiming for the
  summer and is looking to do a tour of historic homes.

  2) City Council Liaison – Civic Awareness Update:
  a. The City’s Housing Element was approved and has been submitted.
  b. New housing will predominantly be concentrated on the Wilshire/La Cienega area,
  and to promote affordability, each housing unit will be smaller than the Beverly Hills
  average.
  c. One Beverly Hills has also broken ground.
 Highlights for March 21, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  d. The Mayor stated his belief that the next decade will be transformative for the city
  due to the development coming from the Metro, One Bevely Hills, and the Housing
  Element.

  3) City Staff Announcements for the Next Generation:
  a. Beverly Hills Staff did an overview of City events for March and April.

  5) Current Business:
  a. Brian stated that the city has several incredible food destinations and with proper
  promotion it could become a food destination in its own right.
  b. Beverly Hills Cop 4 is coming out soon and the city is working with Netflix on
  promotional events and materials.

  6) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: March 19, 2024 / 7:55 PM
